summary_1line: Agastya recounts finding a mysterious corpse and a radiant celestial who descends in a swan-drawn chariot to eat it, prompting Agastya’s questioning.

image_candidates.scene_text: A radiant youth descends from a swan-drawn celestial chariot surrounded by singing apsaras and bends to devour a shining corpse beside a lotus-filled lake.
Sage Agastya stands at dawn beside a tranquil lake of lotuses and swans, staring in astonishment at a spotless corpse floating in the clear water.
The celestial chariot hovers above the wilderness as apsaras dance and play instruments while white swans strain against the harness in midair.
